decisions.reason: As a flagship closely tied to the firm’s core waste-to-energy capabilities, it is likely to be retained despite uncertain short-term results because growing industry demand, ongoing hiring, and available innovative slack lower the pressure to redeploy its resources immediately.

Although more commercially and technically uncertain than Product C, its strong fit with the firm’s circular-fuel strategy and the firm’s R&D-oriented, exploratory posture make continued support more likely than withdrawal unless performance clearly falls below aspirations.
